businessDifference.conflictSummary: 旧文档已要求 success/cancel/final-fail 停止生产，但 eager producer 在成功回报前已经启动后续 OCR，且 Map 删除无法停止持有 Session 引用的线程。
businessDifference.userDecision: 同一 NPC 请求打开 Dialog 后，来自同一任务的其余识别请求全部关闭，不能继续。可点击候选必须成为生产栅栏；失败才允许下一候选。

connectivity.producer: Cloud SmartClickRecognizer 按 MEMORY、TOOLTIP、YELLOW_NAME、PURPLE_FORMULA、CTRL_CANDIDATES 顺序向 NpcClickSmartQueueStore.Session push 候选。
connectivity.transport: Client 通过 NPC arrival FIFO poll 取得一个候选，执行 exact-window 原子点击和本地 verifier；失败后同 session 的下一次 poll 是继续信号，terminal outcome 通过现有 REPORT HTTP 回传。
connectivity.consumer: NpcClickSmartQueueStore.Session 在可点击候选 push 后暂停 producer；下一次 poll 只放行失败后的后续策略，terminal REPORT 终止 producer 并清空剩余消息。
connectivity.ordering: candidate computed -> actionable candidate pushed -> producer paused -> Client click and verifier -> failure then next poll releases producer OR success/terminal REPORT cancels producer; no later OCR may start on success

proves: an actionable tooltip pauses later strategy production until the Client requests another message
VERIFIED terminates the producer and prevents the next OCR stage from starting
VERIFICATION_FAILED followed by the next poll releases exactly the next strategy
terminal cancellation clears queued messages and wakes a blocked producer
an earlier no-action miss cannot release a later actionable tooltip
